|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of a '''retired''' Virtual Modern card. '''Retired:''' the PC card data lists this card as GEMP <code>200_90</code> (“Sith Probe Droid (V)”) up to 14 October 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/4f5ce3088f0b72912df2eac71cf959b4b0963e2c card-json commit 4f5ce30]); from 29 December 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/304ab4f68b7ed22cc324c8ffbb678420825c9ce1 card-json commit 304ab4f], “Set 24”) slot <code>200_90</code> holds [[DRK-1 (Dark Eye Probe Droid)]], whose image was added on 26 December 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/934fb059221a75497db7d1bb505f5cbfc24098cf holotable commit 934fb05]). The file name was reused: on 30 December 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b holotable commit 9d2c01e]) the PC overwrote <code>Virtual0-Dark/large/sithprobedroid.gif</code> with a copy of the [[DRK-1 (Dark Eye Probe Droid)]] image (pixel-identical to <code>drk1darkeyeprobedroid.gif</code> of 26 December 2024, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/934fb059221a75497db7d1bb505f5cbfc24098cf holotable commit 934fb05]); that copy belongs to DRK-1 and is not a version of this card. Bill ruled (12 November 2026, on [[Jabba's Prize (V)]] and [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol]]) that a card whose GEMP slot was reused for another card is not part of the new card's family, so this card keeps its own version history here and is not listed with [[DRK-1 (Dark Eye Probe Droid)]]. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-sithprobedroid-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-V0-D-sithprobedroid022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithprobedroid.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018). Status of the file today: the PC now serves the DRK-1 (Dark Eye Probe Droid) image under this file name (since 30 December 2024).</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Sith Probe Droid”. Text: “When drawn for destiny during a battle or duel involving a Dark Jedi, destiny +2. During your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Dark Jedi (with any captives they are escorting) to same site; place this droid in Used Pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Sith Probe Droid (V) (Virtual Set 0) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-V0-D-sithprobedroidab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithprobedroid.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022). Status of the file today: the PC now serves the DRK-1 (Dark Eye Probe Droid) image under this file name (since 30 December 2024).</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels) with a re-coloured picture; the game text now breaks the line after its first sentence; the words of the game text, the mark and the margin are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Sith Probe Droid”. Text: “When drawn for destiny during a battle or duel involving a Dark Jedi, destiny +2. During your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Dark Jedi (with any captives they are escorting) to same site; place this droid in Used Pile.”

The file name was reused: on 30 December 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b holotable commit 9d2c01e]) the PC overwrote <code>Virtual0-Dark/large/sithprobedroid.gif</code> with a copy of the [[DRK-1 (Dark Eye Probe Droid)]] image (pixel-identical to <code>drk1darkeyeprobedroid.gif</code> of 26 December 2024, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/934fb059221a75497db7d1bb505f5cbfc24098cf holotable commit 934fb05]); that copy belongs to DRK-1 and is not a version of this card.
